India's Defence Minister Rejects Broader Talks with Pakistan

Defence minister Rajnath Singh stated that India will only engage in talks with Pakistan over the disputed region of PoK. He rejected broader talks, citing Pakistan's alleged promotion of terrorism as a state policy. Singh made this statement during Kargil Vijay Diwas celebrations. The Defence Minister also mentioned Operation Sindoor, which he claimed sent a clear message to Pakistan. India has been seeking a resolution on the Kashmir issue for years.
